## API Docs
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [What this deployment can do](https://docs.callerapi.com/what-this-deployment-can-do-43843793e0.md): Reports which products are on and the credit prices in force. `live_filter` must be `true` before you open the filter socket. Free.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [List the verdict categories](https://docs.callerapi.com/list-the-verdict-categories-43843794e0.md): Every value `verdict.category` can take, with a description. The values are the exact CallerAPI complaint subjects, so a filed complaint carries the same string as `GET /api/lookup/{phone}`. `none` means a clean call. Free.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [List the honeypot personas](https://docs.callerapi.com/list-the-honeypot-personas-43843795e0.md): The cast the honeypot picks from. Pass an `id` as the `persona` option to use one character on every call. Free.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [Score a transcript or a recording](https://docs.callerapi.com/score-a-transcript-or-a-recording-43843796e0.md): Classify one call after the fact. Send a transcript, or audio as base64 or as a multipart file named `audio`. Exactly one of transcript or audio is required. Costs 2 credits per request plus 1 credit per started minute of uploaded audio. A request rejected with 400 costs nothing. The body limit is 25 MB. The request times out after 90 seconds.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [List your recent sessions](https://docs.callerapi.com/list-your-recent-sessions-43843797e0.md): Filter, honeypot, and scan sessions that belong to this key, newest first. Free.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [Get one session with verdict and intel](https://docs.callerapi.com/get-one-session-with-verdict-and-intel-43843799e0.md): The session record plus `verdict` and `intel` as objects. Use it to recover a missed webhook post or to answer a dispute. Free.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [Twilio voice URL for a screened number](https://docs.callerapi.com/twilio-voice-url-for-a-screened-number-43843800e0.md): Set this URL as the voice URL of a Twilio number. It returns TwiML that forks the caller's audio to the filter socket and dials `forward`. Twilio posts `From`, `To`, and `CallSid` as form fields. The endpoint copies `From` and `To` onto the stream. Events go to `webhook` only. GET is accepted as well so the URL can be checked in a browser.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [Preview the Twilio TwiML](https://docs.callerapi.com/preview-the-twilio-twiml-43843801e0.md): Same as POST. Open it in a browser to check the XML before you save the URL in the Twilio console.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [Telnyx voice URL for a screened number](https://docs.callerapi.com/telnyx-voice-url-for-a-screened-number-43843802e0.md): Set this URL as the Voice URL of a Telnyx TeXML Application. It returns TeXML that forks the caller's audio to the filter socket with `codec="PCMU"` and dials `forward`. Telnyx sends `from` and `to` in the stream start frame. Events go to `webhook` only.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [Twilio voice URL for a honeypot number](https://docs.callerapi.com/twilio-voice-url-for-a-honeypot-number-43843803e0.md): Set this URL as the voice URL of a Twilio number. It returns TwiML that connects the call to the honeypot socket in both directions. A persona answers and the call stays up until the persona hangs up. At most 15 minutes. 8 credits per started minute.
- Spam protection > Voice firewall > REST [Telnyx voice URL for a honeypot number](https://docs.callerapi.com/telnyx-voice-url-for-a-honeypot-number-43843804e0.md): Set this URL as the Voice URL of a Telnyx TeXML Application. It returns TeXML with `bidirectionalMode="rtp"`, `bidirectionalCodec="PCMU"`, and `codec="PCMU"` that connects the call to the honeypot socket. At most 15 minutes. 8 credits per started minute.

- Spam protection > Daily spam reports > Webhook [Unsubscribe from daily reports](https://docs.callerapi.com/unsubscribe-from-daily-reports-22518559e0.md): :::info

- Spam protection > Daily spam reports > Webhook [Test webhook](https://docs.callerapi.com/test-webhook-22518653e0.md): :::info
- Spam protection > Daily spam reports > REST [Fetch daily spam reports](https://docs.callerapi.com/fetch-daily-spam-reports-19958865e0.md): :::info
- Spam protection [Spam score + HLR](https://docs.callerapi.com/spam-score-hlr-19887237e0.md): This endpoint allows you to see the phone number status and entity type (owner)
- Business Caller ID > REST [Verify the calling number](https://docs.callerapi.com/verify-the-calling-number-43957284e0.md): Call this from the switch or SBC at INVITE, before the phone rings. Send the calling number and the called number. The response says whether the registered owner announced this exact call.
- Business Caller ID > REST [Fetch the logo](https://docs.callerapi.com/fetch-the-logo-43957285e0.md): Returns the reviewed logo as PNG. Use the `identity.logo_id` from a verified response. The id is a content address, so the image never changes under it. Cache it. The response carries `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`. No API credit is charged. Artwork still in review is not served.
- Business Caller ID > REST [Announce a call](https://docs.callerapi.com/announce-a-call-43957286e0.md): Call this from the originating dialler at dial time. This is an HTTP request. It is not a SIP header.
- DID monitoring > REST [Submit numbers](https://docs.callerapi.com/submit-numbers-46247950e0.md): Adds phone numbers to monitoring. Send numbers in E.164 format. You can also send national numbers with `default_country`. Send at most 100,000 numbers in one request.
- DID monitoring > REST [List number status](https://docs.callerapi.com/list-number-status-46247951e0.md): Returns all monitored numbers with the result of the last check. Use this request to get the full results for all your numbers. Webhooks send only changes.
- DID monitoring > REST [Read one number](https://docs.callerapi.com/read-one-number-46247952e0.md): Returns the result of the last check for one monitored number.
- DID monitoring > REST [Remove a number](https://docs.callerapi.com/remove-a-number-46247953e0.md): Use this request to remove one number from monitoring. After you remove the number, the system stops all checks for it. The system also stops status updates, webhook notifications and email alerts for it. The system deletes webhook events that are pending for the number.
- DID monitoring > REST [Read the check schedule](https://docs.callerapi.com/read-the-check-schedule-46247954e0.md): Returns the check schedule and a credit estimate for one month.
- DID monitoring > REST [Set the check schedule](https://docs.callerapi.com/set-the-check-schedule-46247955e0.md): Sets when CallerAPI checks your numbers. Send only the fields that you want to change. The other fields keep their saved values.
- DID monitoring > REST [Save the webhook URL](https://docs.callerapi.com/save-the-webhook-url-46247956e0.md): Saves the URL that receives webhook events. An account has one webhook URL. A new save replaces the old URL.
- DID monitoring > REST [Read the webhook](https://docs.callerapi.com/read-the-webhook-46247957e0.md): Returns the webhook URL and its delivery state. The response does not contain the secret.
- DID monitoring > REST [Delete the webhook](https://docs.callerapi.com/delete-the-webhook-46247958e0.md): Deletes the webhook URL and its secret. CallerAPI stops all deliveries. Events that are not delivered yet are not sent.
- DID monitoring > REST [Send a test event](https://docs.callerapi.com/send-a-test-event-46247959e0.md): Sends one signed `webhook.test` event to your webhook URL. Use it to test your signature check. The response gives the HTTP status that your endpoint returned.
- DID monitoring > REST [Rotate the webhook secret](https://docs.callerapi.com/rotate-the-webhook-secret-46247960e0.md): Makes a new signing secret and returns it one time. For 24 hours, CallerAPI signs each event with the new secret and with the old secret. Update your receiver in this time. After 24 hours, only the new secret signs.
